headline: NEITHER PACKET WAS REBUILT AND NEITHER FAMILY IS DISCHARGED. One of the four pinned sources for both families, the EXP-AD Case List (sha256 b72d30d274b061e0671933b8bd65abf7d2c37a6f1dd4ebfbf3968bc55b9bed0c, 744,328 bytes), lives in the nationwide_recovery_pool_2026_09_02 custody. That custody is mounted in no container reachable from this worktree and is carried by no release; its official publisher URL is refused by the egress policy. Both builders' resolveSources() therefore refuse, correctly and by name, and no byte of either packet was produced here. The delivered fixture digests are unchanged from the base and identical to the ones VF01 read. What this lane did instead is repair the remaining causes in the two builders, prove each repair non-vacuously without the corpus, and measure both delivered packets at appearance level so the next lane inherits a measured state rather than a claim.
scope: The four obligations VF01 failed on the two granted families, repaired at the cause in each family's own builder. No route key, source pin, protected court field, appearance registry entry, fact registry entry, specification, legal record, RASTER_QUEUE.json or MASTER_QUEUE.json was touched, and no shared helper was changed.

LEGAL INPUT, two items. (a) The Illinois record states who serves, who is served and the objection window, but does not state the manner in which the clerk transmits notice; that one element is declared BLOCKED_LEGAL_INPUT in the field-map disclosure and in the prose rather than guessed, and it is not a participant step either way. (b) The Outcome cell of the active sealing row prints the shared Illinois fixture word 'Dismissed' while the same Request elects item 17, a misdemeanor conviction or ordinance violation sealed after two years; a conviction being sealed was not dismissed, so the packet asserts two dispositions. It is NOT repaired here because the route does not settle it: the Request's own Outcome Abbreviations for Sealing legend offers MC, FC, CE and QP, item 17 covers a misdemeanor conviction OR an ordinance violation, an ordinance violation has no abbreviation in that legend, and which of the two a record is, is a fact the platform does not hold. Writing either would be an invention. This is a new finding of this lane, outside the four obligations, and it needs a legal-input answer before the cell can be written or refused.
